name: The Supply Chain
description: Three coastal settlements from Karachi to Colombo have requested medical supplies. The Navigator has the cargo. She needs crew who can handle raiders on the approaches to each settlement.

stages.name: Deliver to Karachi Settlement
stages.description: The first delivery stop is outside the old Karachi port. Raiders have set up on the coastal road — deal with them before the Navigator's cargo can reach the settlement.

stages.name: Deliver to Goa Settlement
stages.description: The second stop is a settlement in the old Goa coastal zone. A different raider band has been taxing supply ships in the harbor approach.

stages.name: Deliver to Colombo Settlement
stages.description: Final delivery to the Colombo settlement on the Sri Lanka coast. The Navigator's most important contact waits here.
